proposals.old_string: - **`FRICTION JONSWAP CONSTANT 0.067`** = default; valid for storms but too dissipative for swell — switch to `FRICTION COLL` or measured Madsen for swell-dominated cases.
proposals.new_string: - **`FRICTION JONSWAP CONSTANT [cfjon]`** — current default `[cfjon] = 0.038` (swanuse v41.51 §4.5.4 FRICTION, online_doc node28 "Default: [cfjon] = 0.038"); `0.067` is **not** the current default. Wind-sea vs swell suitability of the two values: see the same manual section before switching to `COLLINS`/`MADSEN`.
proposals.rationale: 값검증 불일치(0.067→0.038) 정정 + 출처 부착; 무출처 storm/swell 단정은 매뉴얼 참조로 대체.

proposals.old_string: 4. **`NESTOUT` writes 2D spectra** — the receiving fine-grid `BOUND NEST` reads them, both grids must share `SET FREQ` and `SET DIR` parameters.
proposals.new_string: 4. **`NESTOUT` writes 2D spectra** — the receiving fine-grid `BOUND NEST` reads them; a differing spectral grid (`CGRID` `[flow] [fhigh] [msc] [mdc]`) is remapped by `CHGBAS` with no hard check ([[swan-boundary-implementation]] §B), so share the `CGRID` spectral settings when exact consistency matters. (`SET FREQ`/`SET DIR` are not SWAN commands.)
proposals.rationale: 존재하지 않는 명령 제거, 'must' 를 자매 노트의 인용된 사실(재매핑)로 교체.

proposals.old_string: 5. **`COMPUTE NONSTAT` time format**: `YYYYMMDD.HHMMSS` (default), or with `SET TIMEFORMAT` set differently — be explicit when sharing scripts.
proposals.new_string: 5. **`COMPUTE NONSTAT` time format**: ISO `YYYYMMDD.HHMMSS` recommended (swanuse §2.8 Time and date notation, [[swan-usage-general]] §5); `SET TIMEFORMAT` is not a SWAN command — be explicit when sharing scripts.
proposals.rationale: 존재하지 않는 명령 제거 + swanuse §2.8 출처 연결.
